descriptions.w3d_set_byte_from_float_801ed62c: Converts the given float to an unsigned byte (quantized store) and passes it to a setter on the target through a pointer to member function.
descriptions.w3d_set_long_from_float_801ed88c: Converts the given float to a 64-bit integer and passes it to a setter on the target through a pointer to member function.
descriptions.w3d_set_float_member_801ed974: Calls a float setter on the target through a pointer to member function with the float pointed to by the last argument.
descriptions.w3d_set_float_member_801ed9cc: Calls a float setter on the target through a pointer to member function with the float pointed to by the last argument.
descriptions.w3d_set_ulong_from_float_801ed900: Converts the given float to a unsigned 64-bit integer and passes it to a setter on the target through a pointer to member function.
